column1: # Hand-picked HD stand-ins (lane hdfx2, 2026-10-29; docs/hd-effects.md section 9). tools/effects_hd.py applies a line to

# offline side-by-sides: Median's classic frames against the classic art each D2R effect stands for.
# Optional (lane picktint): tint = a colour ramp of tools/hd_recolour.py RAMPS (gold, green, red, fire, violet) mapped onto the
# effect's colourful gradients, or `<ramp>:<gradient stem>+<stem>` for named (grey-ish) ones; rows = the only missile rows
# (comma list) the line is for, which then wins even where D2R draws the art itself.
